verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
KINO kya kitalo nnyo
Ekitalabwanga;
Emirembe gizze nno
Mu nsi yaffe muno.
Ka tuyimbe nate,

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Ekitiibwa eri Katonda
N'emirembe mu nsi.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Bayimbira Kabaka
Mukama w'eggulu;
Ensozi n'ebiwonvu
Mwenna musanyuke:
Fenna ka tuyimbe,

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Ekitiibwa eri Katonda
N'emirembe mu nsi.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Entiisa y'omulabe
Leero tekyaliwo;
Yesu Mukama waffe
Azaaliddwa leero:
Tuyimbe n'essanyu,

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Ekitiibwa eri Katonda
N'emirembe mu nsi.
